cards.subtitle: Last seen jogging near her Placentia apartment

cards.title: Attacked at Dusk
cards.subtitle: Found stabbed in her vehicle the next morning

cards.title: A Boyfriend Cleared
cards.subtitle: Investigators had a theory but no proof

cards.title: Genetic Genealogy
cards.subtitle: A coworker arrested in 2019 through familial DNA

ctaLine: Follow Cold Trail for cases the mainstream forgot
voiceover:
February thirteenth, nineteen ninety four. A college student was found stabbed to death in her car, parked outside her own apartment.

Cathy Torrez was twenty years old, working at a university library while finishing her degree in Southern California.

She never returned from an evening jog. The next morning, neighbors found her body in her locked Honda Civic.

Detectives suspected her ex-boyfriend but had no physical evidence. The case went cold for twenty five years.

In twenty nineteen, genetic genealogy identified a former coworker. Sam Herrera was arrested and convicted of her murder.

Follow Cold Trail for cases the mainstream forgot.
